Track work blocks by category with pause/resume, weekly targets and local history. Notification delivery depends on device permissions and power policies.

This page describes the October 2026 source revision. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

[Current implementation, prerequisites and commands](../current-status.qmd)

## Task and calendar integrations

Optional FlowSavvy integration links focus sessions to tasks, reports active minutes and requires confirmation before completing a task. Calendar reminders support system-synced calendars on iOS and direct read-only CalDAV on Android/desktop. See the [setup and verification guide](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-focus/blob/main/docs/integrations-2026-11.md).
